ops.title: Surface fatal UV invocation errors before waiting for product publication
ops.description:
During genuine public Capt12.108.17/SDK14.45.31 adoption, an offline environment supplied to the normal package installer conflicted with its required uv pip compile --refresh-package preflight. One exact metadata probe returned exit2 and explicit UV_OFFLINE/--refresh argument-conflict stderr. Actual source7bd4a3876abe32fb0d9933e9b95ddb0344dcfc1d internal/hookd/toolrelease.go awaitProductRelease calls awaitResolvable before installProductToolEnv/apply; awaitResolvable retries every exec.ExitError for up to10min and hides stderr until deadline, including this fatal configuration error. The stuck helper44087 had no descendants/onlystdio+kqueue; App14 and host17env-absent state proved it was pre-lifecycle.

Root relayed explicit user authority to cancel this task isolated helper after fresh fullidentity/ancestry/children/source proof. Only44087 was signalled; original controller exited241/reaped. Removing only incompatible UV_OFFLINE made the exact metadata probe succeed; a freshguard and normal supported install then exited0, and matching App17/globalCLI17/host79755/8workers/owner80656/nativef8a4 plus ONE installed pressure case passed. Original logs, exact probes and cancellation evidence remain under RUN/capt-12.108.17-install. This finding does not gate or invalidate that completed adoption and does not justify signalling protected nodes or weakening normal publication refresh.

Own a durable narrow fix only after verifying the real installed uv0.13.6 exit-code/error contract from official docs/source. Distinguish documented fatal invocation/configuration failure from legitimate not-yet-published resolution retries; do not guess from stderr substrings or blanket-fail transient publication. Preserve current source/SDK31, strict matching, deadlines, legitimate poll/cancel and error evidence. Future installer templates omit incompatible offline environment when their normal preflight refreshes metadata. Use isolated reviewed source and meaningful old-fail/new-pass existing normal CI; no local product tests/builds/imports or additional live install case without Root ordering.

ops.text: Bind the actual UV exit-code and fatal-configuration contract to official documentation/source; retain exact observed stderr and distinguish legitimate publication-resolution retries.

Ship a narrow source-reviewed fix with meaningful old-fail/new-pass normal CI preserving refresh, legitimate retry/cancel, source and SDK31 compatibility; retain corrected installer templates and exact delivery proof.
